title: Credit Card Games
subtitle: Money becomes a multiplayer medium.
thesis: Every confirmed contribution makes one beautiful public move; enough moves unlock a specific real-world outcome.

launch_game.name: Light the Block
launch_game.move: One fixed contribution illuminates one window and adds an optional three-word dedication.
launch_game.completion: The hundredth confirmed move unlocks a named performance, dinner, print run, or public object.

edition_01: The Last Move Starts the Show

base_case_model.note: Scenario, not forecast or investment valuation.

non_negotiables: One confirmed contribution creates one disclosed move.
No random financial prize or pay-to-win dominance.
Raw payment-card details stay with the payment provider.
Refunded and disputed funds remain distinct from confirmed moves.
Every promised outcome receives a public completion receipt.
